newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait bourse to list two local firms.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait bourse to list two local firms.

text.p: Kuwait Stock Exchange (KSE) has approved the listing of two local firms, bringing the total number of traded concerns to 63, a KSE official said on Monday.
"The committee has approved the listing of KFC (Kuwait Financial Centre) share and it will be traded today (Monday)," a KSE official said.
"It also approved the listing of the Sultan Center (Food Products Company SCFPC) which will be traded on Wednesday," he added.
KFC, established in 1974, reported a 1996 net profit of 1.67 million dinars ($5.5 million) compared with 1.59 million in 1995 and 16.86 million dinars in 1994, according to KSE figures.
KFC activities include financing of imports and exports and securing bank facilities for clients.

Earning per KFC share was 16.99 fils in 1996 compared with 16.51 in 1995 and 174.5 in 1994 while total assets were valued at 15.41 million dinars at the end of 1996 and 19.79 million the previous year.
There are 1,000 fils to the dinar.

SCFPC, which had its name changed from Kuwaiti for Manufacturing Salted Foods Company in January 1996, reported a net profit of 871,000 dinars in 1996 from zero in 1995 and a loss of 57,000 in 1994. Total assets tripled to 60 million dinars in the end of 1996 from the previous year.
There are 61 traded concerns on the Kuwaiti exchange with a market capitalisation of 7.033 billion dinars at the end of the first quarter of 1997, according to an independent study.
